sents.t: Marlene White is inside her bathroom when she captures something really creepy on camera.
sents.zh: Marlene White 在浴室里时，拍到了非常诡异的东西。

sents.t: Marlene writes, "Please tell me that I'm not crazy."
sents.zh: Marlene 写道：“请告诉我，我没有疯。”

sents.t: Here's the video she posted, along with the text-to-speech voice that she uses to explain what's going on.
sents.zh: 这是她发布的视频，她用文字转语音的声音来解释发生了什么。

sents.t: What the hell is this?
sents.zh: 这到底是什么鬼？

sents.t: I only have one baby at my house today. The rest of them are with Grandma.
sents.zh: 今天家里只有一个孩子，其他孩子都在外婆家。

sents.t: You can clearly hear my baby in the living room crying.
sents.zh: 你能清楚听到我的孩子在客厅里哭。

sents.t: I was on the toilet when I felt like something was watching me.
sents.zh: 我坐在马桶上时，感觉有什么东西在盯着我。

sents.t: I've been on edge ever since.
sents.zh: 从那以后我就一直很紧张。

sents.t: I took a picture, and my dad was behind me by the door, so I decided to turn the camera on and record.
sents.zh: 我拍了张照片，照片里我爸就在我身后的门边，所以我决定打开摄像头录像。

sents.t: This is not my dad. I don't know what it is.
sents.zh: 这不是我爸。我不知道它是什么。

sents.t: I know you've seen it move before and after I gasp.
sents.zh: 我知道你们看到了：在我倒吸一口气之前和之后，它都动了。

sents.t: Who are you?
sents.zh: 你是谁？

sents.t: Now, it kind of looks like someone is standing inside.
sents.zh: 看起来有点像有人站在里面。

sents.t: Maybe it's one of her children.
sents.zh: 也许是她的某个孩子。

sents.t: But Marlene disproves this notion by showing us what it would actually look like if one of her children were standing inside.
sents.zh: 但 Marlene 为了推翻这种说法，给我们演示了如果真是她的孩子站在里面，会是什么样子。

sents.t: Stand in the shower real quick so I can show people something.
sents.zh: 快去淋浴间里站一下，我给大家看个东西。

sents.t: Please shut the door.
sents.zh: 请把门关上。

sents.t: Okay, you can get out. Come here, child.
sents.zh: 好了，你可以出来了。过来，孩子。

sents.t: This is literally what you guys want, like...
sents.zh: 这就是你们想看的……

sents.t: That was not my babies in the shower.
sents.zh: 淋浴间里的不是我的孩子。

sents.t: Please just stop. There's no way.
sents.zh: 别再说了，不可能的。

sents.t: I would never get in that scary thing. I'm so scared.
sents.zh: 我才不会进那个吓人的地方。我好害怕。

sents.t: Marlene has no idea as to what this might be, but viewers can't help but think that this might have been a ghost.
sents.zh: Marlene 完全不知道这是什么，但观众忍不住觉得这可能是鬼。

sents.t: But what do you think?
sents.zh: 你怎么看？

sents.t: Ghost or illusion?
sents.zh: 是鬼，还是错觉？
